verdict.rationale: Smooth documents programmatic session management through its REST API: creating persistent browser sessions, listing and cancelling tasks, and sending session actions such as goto, extract and close. Nothing in the evidence documents running many sessions in parallel or states any concurrency limits, which are the core of the scale story. missing for 10: documented concurrent/parallel session support, published concurrency limits or quotas, fleet-level orchestration, independent corroboration of running at scale.
